description: This file contains helper functions for managing the state and structure of a specific dynamic table component related to Slide 3 in a presentation builder UI. It includes functions for normalizing headers, creating empty rows, normalizing existing rows, and resetting table data when columns change. The code is primarily concerned with maintaining consistency and handling legacy data structures within the presentation project's slide rendering/export logic.

methods.name: normalizeHeaders(headers)
methods.description: Normalizes a list of headers by ensuring all elements are strings, trimmed, and filtering out empty headers unless explicitly included.

methods.name: createEmptyRowForHeaders(headers)
methods.description: Creates a new empty row, which is an array of empty strings, matching the length of the headers.

methods.name: normalizeRowsForHeaders(headers, rows)
methods.description: Normalizes a set of data rows to match the current headers, handling arrays, legacy object shapes, and invalid data by returning safe, consistent rows.

methods.name: sf3CreateEmptyRow(columns)
methods.description: Public function that creates an empty row based on the current column configuration.

methods.name: sf3NormalizeTableState(slide3)
methods.description: Public function that takes a slide3 table state object and normalizes its columns and rows to the canonical format used internally.

methods.name: sf3ResetRowsForNewColumns(nextColumns, prevRowsCount = 0)
methods.description: Public function to reset all rows in the table to empty, matching new column headers while retaining the row count.
